text:
anya: quick RFC follow-up re: 'consolidation corridor' idea — propose a 3-phase migration for the legacy session+enricher code in the monolith: 1) feature split + thin proxy, 2) dual-write + reconcile, 3) cutover. want alignment on compatibility guarantees and an SLO impact budget. TL;DR: aim for 6-9 months, incremental owners, and an explicit tech-debt amortization lane. pls chime in :wave:

mike: high level sounds good. main worry is the session read path — any added latency from thin proxy could regress p50. can we keep hot-path reads pinned to the monolith until warm caches sync? :thinking:

anya: yeah, plan is hot reads sticky during phase1. proxy only routes writes and read-fallbacks. cold reads get gradual traffic as KV warm-up finishes. we'll define a latency budget per route in the rollout doc.

sara: curious about data migration strategy — dual-write sounds risky for inconsistencies. do we have an anti-entropy/reconcile pattern in mind?

devon: propose periodic reconcile job + tombstone markers. simple sketch: 
```python
# reconcile_v1_v2.py (pseudo)
for key in keys_to_check():
    v1 = monolith_store.get(key)
    v2 = corridor_store.get(key)
    if v1 != v2:
        corridor_store.upsert(key, v1)
        metrics.incr('reconcile.updates')
```
run hourly initially, then backoff once divergence < threshold.

raj: we should also add a canary header-based routing switch (X-MIGRATE) and metric tags so Redwood Console can show delta error/latency per cohort. If canary shows >1% error or +10ms p50, auto-fallback.

anya: good call. will add gating that can flip route at infra level. also adding contract tests to prevent subtle API drift — see mike's point about p50.

mike: contract tests + a deprecation window policy please. suggest: 12-week deprecation window for public surface changes, 2-week for internal-only. add a CI job that runs synthetic traffic against both endpoints and fails the PR on mismatches.

sara: I can own the contract test harness. will add a small mocha test that runs the Golden prompt set and checks shape + key fields.

devon: adding reconciler plus a 'drain' script for final cutover. quick drain snippet: 
```bash
# mark service read-only then wait for in-flight jobs
curl -XPOST http://admin/flags/consolidation?state=read-only
sleep 60
# run final reconcile
python reconcile_v1_v2.py --finalize
# flip router
curl -XPOST http://router/rollout -d '{"route":"corridor"}'
```

anya: love it. next steps: write a migration playbook, estimate engineering weeks for phase1/2/3, and nominate owners for each slice. I put a stub in the RFC doc. asking owners to comment by EOW. :spiral_calendar_pad: 

raj: +1, I'm ok to own the rollout gating and metrics dashboards. will prototype a lightweight dashboard in Redwood Console to surface canary diffs.

sara: volunteering for contract tests + assist on data migrate tests.

mike: will do perf measurements on staging for thin-proxy to validate p50 impact.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: staging/consolidation-corridor-proxy v0.1 -> will run integration smoke (will post results here).
